findings.body: `active_batch_ids` is collected only from rows returned by the answer query (`backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:74`), so a month whose active batch contributed no selected rows is absent from `contributing`. If that month reloads between the answer query and `findActiveActualPins`, this condition leaves `changed` false because `executed` is undefined, then adds the new batch to the predicates. A budget-only displayed row with Actual 0 can therefore become drillable when the replacement contains different lines netting to 0, and its link opens transactions that were not behind the displayed answer. The new reload test covers only a period already present in provenance. Complete-window pins must come from the execution snapshot, or extra post-query pins must fail closed when their identity cannot be verified.
findings.title: Pin completion still accepts a reload in a noncontributing month

findings.body: The wiring test still fabricates the query result, labels, and summaries through `makeFixture`; the frontend label/disclosure tests separately mock the Ask response. No browser flow against the running API and real database proves scoped SAP-name selection, budget fallback, bare-code fallback, complete keyboard/touch disclosure accessibility, and unchanged row order through the actual query-to-browser path. Under the required test-audit rule for user-facing Done-when items, item 1 remains proven only at isolated boundaries.
findings.title: Not done: An Ask answer by GL code shows its scoped SAP/MIS names

findings.body: The saved multi-period statement test injects a fabricated result and `FakeNames` label, while the frontend test also supplies a mocked response. There is no browser flow through a running API and real database proving that a saved/pinned statement re-run resolves and renders the final-month outline's number/name while an actual-only answer without a budget batch remains raw. Done-when item 2 therefore lacks the required end-to-end proof.
findings.title: Not done: A budget-backed statement answer shows pinned line numbers and names

findings.body: The new size-limit rule says an oversized row carries no amount, but the generic context description at lines 82–84 still says every row binds its exact-paise Actual, and C5a at lines 223–224 repeats that each row carries one. These requirements remain mutually exclusive despite the implementation's discriminated union. Explicitly exempt the C5d inert variant in both generic descriptions.
findings.title: Keep oversized context rows consistent in the confirmed spec

findings.body: The task table still assigns rendering drillable Actuals as buttons and proving inert cells make no request to GL-DRILL-PANEL. The current Ask panel consumes labels but not `AskResponse.drill`, so this branch alone does not complete Done-when item 6's user-visible interaction. Per the explicit task assignment, this is a later-task gap rather than a blocker attributed to this backend wiring task.
findings.title: Later: GL-DRILL-PANEL must consume the signed drill metadata
